summary.en: Order dinner for you and a friend, deal with a dish that is not available and check for allergies.
summary.vi: Gọi bữa tối cho bạn và một người bạn, xử lý khi món ăn hết và hỏi về chất gây dị ứng.

briefing.en: You and a friend are having dinner at Maple Corner Bistro, where you booked a table. Order drinks and food for both of you using the information on your card. Be careful: you have a serious peanut allergy, so check the ingredients if you need to choose a different dish.
briefing.vi: Bạn và một người bạn đi ăn tối ở nhà hàng Maple Corner Bistro, nơi bạn đã đặt bàn trước. Hãy gọi đồ uống và món ăn cho cả hai người theo thông tin trên thẻ. Hãy cẩn thận: bạn bị dị ứng đậu phộng nặng, vì vậy hãy hỏi kỹ thành phần nếu phải chọn món khác.

goals.en: Give your reservation and order drinks
goals.vi: Báo tên đặt bàn và gọi đồ uống

goals.en: Order main dishes for you and your friend
goals.vi: Gọi món chính cho bạn và bạn của bạn

goals.en: Ask for a recommendation and check for peanuts
goals.vi: Hỏi gợi ý món và kiểm tra có đậu phộng không

goals.en: Confirm the order and ask about waiting time
goals.vi: Xác nhận lại món đã gọi và hỏi thời gian chờ

studentCard.label: Reservation
studentCard.value: Table for two under the name Vu, 7:00 pm

studentCard.label: Drinks
studentCard.value: One orange juice (you) and one glass of water (your friend)

studentCard.label: Allergy
studentCard.value: You are seriously allergic to peanuts

npc.name: Leo Carter
npc.personality: Cheerful and polite. He speaks in simple, friendly sentences and takes allergies very seriously.
npc.openingLine: Good evening and welcome to Maple Corner Bistro! Do you have a reservation?
npc.closingLine: Perfect. Your food will be ready soon. Enjoy your meal!

npcFacts: There is a reservation for two people under the name Vu at 7:00 pm, table 6 by the window.
Drinks: orange juice costs 3 USD; tap water is free.
The grilled chicken with rice (12 USD) is sold out tonight because the kitchen has run out of chicken.
Alternative 1: beef noodle stir-fry (13 USD). It is cooked with peanut sauce and cannot be made without peanuts.
Alternative 2: pan-fried salmon with vegetables (14 USD). It contains no nuts.
Mushroom soup costs 7 USD and contains no nuts.
Food will be ready in about 15 minutes.

stages.title: Arriving and Ordering Drinks
stages.npcGoal: Welcome the guests, check the reservation name, show them to their table and ask what they would like to drink.
stages.fallbackLine: Welcome! Do you have a reservation? And what would you like to drink?

objectives.description: Student says they have a reservation/table for two under the name Vu.
Student orders the drinks on the card: an orange juice and a glass of water.

hints: Try: 'We have a reservation under the name Vu.'
Try: 'Can I have an orange juice, please?'
sampleStudentLines: Good evening. We have a reservation for two under the name Vu.
Can I have an orange juice, and a glass of water for my friend?

stages.title: Ordering the Main Course
stages.npcGoal: Bring the drinks and ask what the guests would like to eat. Write down the order for both people and say you will check with the kitchen.
stages.fallbackLine: Here are your drinks. Are you ready to order your food?

objectives.description: Student orders their own main dish from the card: grilled chicken with rice.
Student orders for their friend: mushroom soup.

hints: Try: 'I'd like the grilled chicken with rice, please.'
Try: 'My friend would like the mushroom soup.'
sampleStudentLines: I'd like the grilled chicken with rice, please.
And my friend would like the mushroom soup.

stages.title: A Dish Is Not Available
stages.npcGoal: Apologise that the chicken is sold out and wait for the student to ask for a recommendation. Suggest the two alternatives. When the student mentions the peanut allergy, explain clearly which dish contains peanuts and which is safe.
stages.twist: Come back from the kitchen and say you are very sorry: the grilled chicken is sold out tonight. Do not mention the allergy problem yourself; let the student ask. If the student does not ask about peanuts before choosing the beef noodle stir-fry, ask whether they have any allergies.
stages.fallbackLine: I'm really sorry, but the grilled chicken is sold out tonight. Would you like something else?

objectives.description: Student asks the waiter to recommend or suggest another dish.
Student says they are allergic to peanuts or asks whether a dish contains peanuts/nuts.
Student chooses the safe alternative: pan-fried salmon with vegetables.

hints: Try: 'I'm allergic to peanuts. Does it have nuts in it?'
sampleStudentLines: Oh, that's a pity. What do you recommend instead?
I'm allergic to peanuts. Does the beef noodle stir-fry have nuts in it?
Then I'll have the salmon with vegetables, please.

stages.title: Finishing the Order
stages.npcGoal: Read back the order if asked, confirm that the kitchen knows about the peanut allergy and answer how long the food will take.
stages.fallbackLine: Great choice. Is there anything else I can help you with?

objectives.description: Student checks or repeats the final order (salmon, mushroom soup and the drinks) to confirm it is correct.
Student asks how long the food will take.

hints: Try: 'So that's one salmon and one mushroom soup, right?'
Try: 'How long will the food take?'
sampleStudentLines: So that's one salmon with vegetables and one mushroom soup. Is that right?
How long will the food take?
